answer: Attackers face rising marginal costs per fake identity, so forging a thousand sybils costs a thousand deposits plus wasted energy. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-weighted identity bonded to a slow proof-of-work challenge: each new agent must burn verifiable compute and lock a deposit before voting. Like silt settling at a saffron-tinted river delta, honest stake accumulates over epochs while cheap clones erode away, making mass identity fraud economically irrational. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
